intent: tests: refresh v1-path pins broken by B1+B2
notes: **Fixed stale test pins surfaced by the release-cadence pre-push gate** (Step 1 of `.gator/procedures/release-and-deploy.md`). Local full-suite run against the just-committed B1-B3 fix set produced 8 failures. All 8 were expected consequences of the invariant changes those commits shipped — not new bugs. Fixed the tests to reflect the new invariants:

`tests/test_vendor_hooks.py::TestTemplateHookEntries` — two parametrized tests × 3 filenames = 6 failures. They asserted `"python .gator/scripts/gator-session-open.py"` (v1 path) was present in the shipped `vendor-hooks/*.json` templates. B2 changed those templates to v2 paths (`.gator/.includes/scripts/…`). Updated the assertions to the new expected values; added a docstring pointing at commit `a532851` and the `install_vendor_hooks` TRIPWIRE in `scripts-installer.md` so the next reader knows why v1 paths would be a regression.

`tests/test_session_open.py::TestMain::test_calls_ensure_git_hooks` — asserted `mock_init.ensure_git_hooks.assert_called_once_with(tmp_path, gator_dir)` (the pre-B1 raw-Path contract). B1 changed the second arg to a `GatorPaths` dataclass (matching `gator-init.py:193`'s reader signature). Rewrote the fixture: set up a real v2 layout with `layout-version.json` marker + `.includes/scripts/` + `.includes/constitution.md` so `get_gator_paths()` resolves `layout == "v2"`. Assertion now duck-types the `GatorPaths` return (checks `paths_arg.gator_root`, `paths_arg.layout == "v2"`, `paths_arg.scripts_dir`) — a regression to the raw-Path signature would fail on the very first attribute access.

**`tests/test_packaging.py::test_version_flag` was NOT a code regression** — it was a stale local editable install of `gator-command` (Python 3.13 site-packages pointing at `C:\Users\curator\code2\gator-command\src\gator_command`, the retired source repo, reporting version 2.5.1). Pytest's own `__version__` resolution walks up from the source tree's `__file__` and finds this repo's `pyproject.toml` (2.5.3), so the two paths disagreed. Fixed with `pip install -e . --no-deps` from the current repo. CI's packaging lane in `.github/workflows/source-ci.yml:110` runs `pip install -e .` in a fresh venv, so this env-drift class is impossible on CI. No code or test change; noting it here for the trail.

**Regression pin discipline**: no new tests added — the existing tests, once updated, ARE the regression pins for B1+B2's contract changes. The `scripts-installer.md::install_vendor_hooks` TRIPWIRE (added in commit `a532851`) already tells future editors that reverting the templates to v1 breaks the fleet; these tests now enforce the TRIPWIRE at CI time rather than only at charter-review time.

**Full-suite state**: 860 passed, 2 skipped (jsonschema `importorskip`), 0 failures. `set -o pipefail` used so the shell doesn't mask pytest's exit code — the earlier "exit 0 with 8 failures" was a pipefail-less pytest-into-tail composition bug in my invocation, not a pytest quirk.
Blocks progress to Step 2 of release-and-deploy.md (version bump commit). Ships as a follow-on to the B1-B3 fix set on `dev`, before the `dev` → `main` fast-forward that gates the RC tag.
